title: Hunting and Gathering
description: After completing Healing a House, Elynea Mothren at Tel Mithryn Apothecary asks for a rare alchemy ingredient â€” a briar heart, daedra heart, giant's toe, hagraven claw, vampire dust, or void salts. Return with the requested ingredient for a variable gold reward.

base_facts: I run the apothecary at Tel Mithryn.
I need rare alchemy ingredients I can't grow in my garden.
Neloth keeps taking all my briar hearts.
I pay well for hard-to-find ingredients.

HEAR_ABOUT_INGREDIENTS: I've asked the traveler to bring me a rare ingredient.
DELIVER_INGREDIENT: The traveler brought me the ingredient I needed.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The traveler delivered the rare ingredient I requested. I paid them a variable gold reward depending on which ingredient they brought.
I pay extra for giant toes, hagraven claws, vampire dust, and void salts. Briar hearts and daedra hearts earn a standard price.
My apothecary supplies are restocked for now with an ingredient I cannot grow in my garden.
If the traveler already had the ingredient on hand, I accepted it immediately without making them leave and come back.

beats.comment: Player learns Elynea needs a rare alchemy ingredient after Healing a House is done.
Player returns with the requested ingredient and completes the quest.
Observational beat: quest finishes at stage 100 after ingredient delivery.
